title: Recursive Probability Coupling: A Falsifiable Synthetic Benchmark Protocol for Coupled-State Dynamics
description: Corrective results draft reformulating RPC as a controlled synthetic benchmark. In 200 paired deterministic seeds, attractive coupling separated from an uncoupled control and recovered after the declared perturbation, satisfying both primary criteria. Dynamic coupling did not outperform matched fixed coupling, and the entropy–curvature diagnostic did not exceed a circular-shift surrogate. Unsupported empirical statements from the prior version are withdrawn. No claim is made about consciousness, human affect, quantum phenomena, or clinical performance.
